part: 2 of 2: sources, job inputs, quoted range, rows, components, Q, enclosure row, E/F, statuses (R47b-R51, R54, R56-R58); part 1 is SYNTHETIC_NAMING_CASES.json

resources.note: INVENTED placeholders shared by every case and by EXAMPLE_INVENTORY.json. They are not the owner-reviewed company resources, which are private. context:brand_table is present only in a contract packet (a job without a 材料清單, O17); the cases that use it say "source: contract".
resources.context:company_name: 示例機電股份有限公司

job_inputs.context:project_name: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

assumptions: Unless a case says otherwise, the source is the company material list (材料清單, R47b) with the columns listed under resources, so the packet has no brand table (O17); the line lies inside the quoted range (R49) of the bill sheet that carries the prices, and every row carries L, M and N from the job inputs (R48) with K, O, P, G and H null.
Input cells are the line's own cells: description (a list when the item has continuation rows), unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, brand, model, remarks. A missing key means an empty cell.

Segments are separated by ，,、；; only (R52). A category chain is a run of segments before the item's own noun that only name a product category: a segment ending in 類, or a word in the glossary's category_words. It is dropped on every line type, but only while a later noun segment remains.

Expected values list only the fields the case is about; "row": false means the line gives no 未填 row and its cells take the stated census role. A row whose C is null has status research_draft with a null reason for C (R57; route v4.1 relaxation, kept in route v4.2).

input.remarks: 業主供料，本項暫不使用

cases.reason: Supply and separate-contract markers do not decide inclusion and are never copied into a field; a remark saying a line is not used does not remove it. Both stay in raw text.

census.lines 3, 3.1, 3.2: excluded_supply; the reason names the marker 業主供料 and says "owner-supplied panel with no priced line inside the quoted range (R50, provisional O10)"

cases.reason: Provisionally (O10), a panel line marked owner-supplied is omitted together with the lines inside it (its numbered descendants 3.1 and 3.2) when no line inside it has a price inside the quoted range. R50 gives the omitted cells the census role excluded_supply. This also omits the not-estimated line 3.1, which R50 alone would make a row.

rows: line 3.1: C XNB, D 3P 50AT, I 不含估價, J 不含估價, Q null
line 3.2: C XPL, D AC220V, Q 150

census.line 3: excluded_supply under the R50 row tests (no price and no status; the marker does not decide inclusion)

cases.reason: A line inside the panel has a price inside the range, so the O10 omission does not apply and each line follows the R50 row tests: the not-estimated and priced lines are rows; the panel line itself has no price and no status. Two readings are open for the owner (FIELD_ROLES R50, note for the owner): the O10 record says "the panel group stays and its lines are rows", which can be read as making line 3 a row too; R50 does not. Under O11, R50 also supersedes O7/R45, which kept every in-panel line. Evaluators declare both readings before scoring.
Never split or merge lines and never add rows: a line naming two devices is one row. Its description is a single segment the glossary does not list, so it goes to D with C null (R52).

expected.group: one-row physical_enclosure group whose name and specification equal A and B; the row is its only member

cases.reason: A priced line supplying an enclosure is one row. A is the enclosure noun from the line, B is built from the stated dimensions, C is the glossary's generic enclosure word, D is what remains after the prefix, the category word, the enclosure noun and the dimensions (SUS304 and 髮絲面 are not rating tokens, so the comma stays), I is null. The brand cell is empty, so J is the company name.

rows.J: 示例機電股份有限公司

cases.reason: The enclosure line names only a generic box, so A comes from its section heading; no dimensions are stated, so B is null. No other row carries A or B, and no groups are formed for the section. 電度表 is a single segment the glossary does not list, so it goes to D (R52).
E and F are copied verbatim from the line's own unit and quantity cells, even when they look implausible. G and H stay null.

cases.reason: F must be a number: a quantity written as text with a unit leaves F null with a reason, and the text stays in raw quantity. 五金類 is the category chain; M6 follows a word that is not a rating token, so the comma stays.

expected.null_reason_C: service and labour line: C is null (R52)

cases.reason: Fee lines are rows only when priced or not estimated. An unnumbered fee line with no price and no status is not a row.
An enclosure is a 盤, 箱 or 櫃 housing devices; 接線盒, 拉線箱 and 既設盤 are not. This is an ordinary material row: no group, A and B null, C null, and no company name in J.

cases.reason: B reads dimensions labelled W/H/D or 寬/高/深 in mm (here 寬, 高, 深 with mm) and is null without mm dimensions. The brand cell is empty, so J is the company name, exactly as the resource states it.

A not-estimated enclosure is an ordinary row: no group, A and B null, C and D per R52 (an enclosure is not an equipment noun, so C is null and D is the description without the prefix), and I = J = 不含估價.
